_nota: Pokémon skins for sale in the Diamond shop (Cosmetics → Pokémon). vitrine = the skins on sale (a model id pmDDDD_NN that exists in public/scenery/mon; 00 and 99 are not skins), precos = a price per skin, padrao = the price of the rest, ate = an end time (ISO UTC, e.g. 2026-12-31T23:59:59Z) or null. A skin is cosmetic: every Pokémon of that species shows it while it's on (Wardrobe → Pokémon).
